reference: Akturk and Camci, Tip Clearance Investigation of a Ducted Fan Used in VTOL Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, Part I: Baseline Experiments and Computational Validation

journal.inspected: Printed pages 021004-2 to 021004-3: Figure 1, Figure 2, Table 1 and section 2.2; operating-point and clearance definitions checked in text.

conference.inspected: Printed pages 1, 3-9: nomenclature, Figures 1-2, Table 1, clearance method and performance comparisons.

source_history: The downloaded conference PDF has a different hash from docs/reading-records-2026-09-25.json. This extraction uses the newly hashed copies above; it does not assert byte identity with the earlier retrieval. The historical record is unchanged.

rotor_pitch.note: Setting datum not dimensioned; do not apply this angle again to the Figure 2 outline.

diffuser_axial_length.note: Described as approximate; do not interpret displayed digits as tolerance.

clearance_labels.locator: Conference pp. 1, 7-9 and journal clearance comparison

blade_stations.locator: Table 1, p. 021004-3; cross-checked with conference Table 1, p. 4
blade_stations.angles: beta1 and beta2 are section end angles illustrated against the axial direction in Figure 2, not section stagger or rotor pitch.
blade_stations.uncertainty: Transcribed displayed values. Half a last displayed digit is a rounding allowance only; manufacturing and measurement uncertainty are unreported.
blade_stations.figure_label_conflict: Figure 2 labels several inner stations differently from Table 1. Use dimensional radii in the table. Do not assign the overlapping curves to table stations by order alone.

image.pixel_origin: top left; x right; y down

digitised_tip.method: Manual selection of the outline, aided by dark-pixel runs in selected columns of the native embedded JPEG. No fitted airfoil, thickness adjustment or smoothing. Surface labels refer to image position, not pressure or suction side.
digitised_tip.calibration: Chord between leading_edge and trailing_edge rows; physical chord from the last blade-stations row. Assume equal image scale in both directions. Export frame: origin at leading edge, +x toward trailing edge, +y toward upper image contour, z=0. This local frame does not locate the section in the rotor.

chosen_extraction_allowances.meaning: Operator-selected sensitivity allowances, not measured errors or confidence intervals. Apply the pixel allowance to points and chord endpoints. Reuse the same perturbation when a point is itself a chord endpoint. Endpoint errors are shared across the trace, so coordinate errors are correlated.

digitised_tip.limits: Printed illustration scale, contour fidelity and endpoint ambiguity have no validated error bound. Intermediate stations overlap and are obscured by an arrow. This is a tip-section polyline for inspection and geometry sensitivity work; it is insufficient to loft the complete reference blade.

operating_point.note: Published nominal point only. The audited performance plots stop below this speed; no matched reference CFD operating point has been selected.

clearance_convention.definition: 100*t/h, with t the radial gap and h the blade height; conference nomenclature p. 1. Rotors of different diameter set the gap in a fixed shroud (conference p. 7).
clearance_convention.audit_formula: For the tabulated rotor, h=Rtip-Rhub and t=Rshroud-Rtip. Export the result beside the printed label, without adjusting either input.
clearance_convention.normalisation: Thrust and power coefficients use casing inner diameter and angular speed in rad/s (conference p. 1 and equations 1-2, p. 6).
clearance_convention.rounding: The displayed shroud radius can account for part of the clearance-label mismatch; the printed percentage alone does not determine an exact CAD gap. Other builds lack complete dimensional rotor records.

missing_geometry.item: Duct meridional contour, chord and axial placement of rotor
missing_geometry.reason: Figure 1 is perspective. Figure 5 contains a scaled meridional mesh view and can constrain part of the duct outline, but complete contour coordinates, wall transitions and a dimensioned assembly datum are absent. Wall/lip ratios alone do not determine a unique shape.
missing_geometry.needed: Author CAD or a dimensioned meridional drawing.

missing_geometry.item: Blade sections below the tip, stacking offsets, hub attachment and root
missing_geometry.reason: Figure 2 contains overlapping contours with a covering arrow; the table supplies chord and end angles only. The first tabulated station is outside the hub. Chord and end angles do not define a unique section.
missing_geometry.needed: Section coordinates and stacking/root definitions, or original rotor CAD.

missing_geometry.item: Hub axial profile, motor and support placement
missing_geometry.reason: A hub radius and support rod diameter/count do not fix the exposed surfaces or their axial positions. These affect flow and the allowed sector symmetry.
missing_geometry.needed: Dimensioned assembly or an explicitly approved omission.

missing_geometry.reason: Metric and inch tip thickness disagree. The clearance label differs from the nominal radius calculation but is compatible with half-last-digit rounding of the printed radii; this is not a measured clearance tolerance.
missing_geometry.needed: Source clarification, toleranced dimensions, or approval of declared reconstruction values.

additional_sources_checked.outcome: Provides the open journal copies and conference paper.
Different smaller rotor; its dimensions were not transferred.
Text and geometry references inspected for additional baseline dimensions. Tip-treatment designs refer back to Part I; no missing baseline contour recovered.

next_owner_action: Obtain source blade sections with stacking/root definitions and dimensioned duct/assembly geometry, plus the thrust/torque/RPM uncertainty definitions. No complete reference mesh is justified by the present inputs.

reuse.original_files_unchanged: The preservation branch is retained. Only selected geometry files, exporter and tests were reused; no plan was imported.
